promotion.title: Promotion and new school year
promotion.subtitle: Prepare the next school year, decide whether each student is promoted, retained, or confirmed as graduating, then apply it to the target year.
promotion.noAccess: This page is for promotion managers
promotion.noAccessBody: Ask a school admin to give your role access to promotion.
promotion.safeBody: Data of the old school year (classes, teacher assignments, scores, and report cards) is never changed. Every step has a preview that saves nothing, and can be run again: what already exists is skipped, not duplicated.
promotion.previewNote: This is only an estimate. Nothing changes until you run it.
promotion.levelUnknownNote: Grade "{level}" is not in the school grade list, so the next grade is unknown and there is no default decision. Moving up needs a recognized grade, so only Retain is available for now.
promotion.levelUnknownBody: Moving up can only be chosen when the class grade is in the school grade list. Fix the grade in School settings, then reload this page.
promotion.graduateWarnTitle: Report cards are not final for students who will graduate
promotion.graduateConfirmBody: {count} students will be set as graduated even though the last-semester report cards of their class are not finalized, and once graduated they no longer appear in the report card list. Cancel and finalize the report cards first, or continue if this is intended.
promotion.yearsTitle: Pick the source year and the target year
promotion.yearsHelp: The source year is the one whose students will be moved up. The target year is the next school year that receives those classes and students.
promotion.noYearsBody: Create the source year and the next academic year first.
promotion.sourceHint: The classes and students of this year are moved up.
promotion.targetHint: Only years that start after the source year can be chosen.
promotion.noTarget: There is no academic year starting after the source year. Create the next academic year first.
promotion.rolloverTitle: Copy classes, assignments, calendar, and curriculum
promotion.rolloverHelp: Creates the {target} classes from the {source} classes: 7A becomes 8A, and first-grade classes are also copied for new students. Final-grade classes are not copied because graduation is decided by the school. You can skip this step if the target-year classes already exist.
promotion.copyClassesHint: Inactive homeroom teachers are not copied.
promotion.copyAssignmentsHint: Which teacher teaches each subject in the copied classes.
promotion.copyCalendarHint: Event dates are shifted by one year; check them again before use. Calendars differ every year, so this option is off by default.
promotion.pickOne: Pick at least one thing to copy.
promotion.noPartPermission: Your account has no permission to copy any part here. Ask the school administrator to add it.
promotion.rolloverConfirmTitle: Copy to the new school year?
promotion.rolloverConfirmBody: Classes, assignments, calendar, and the curriculum or teaching materials you chose, from {source} will be created in {target}. Data of {source} is not changed. If run again, what already exists is skipped.
promotion.rolloverDone: Copy finished: {classes} classes, {assignments} assignments, and {events} events created.
promotion.decisionsHelp: The default is promotion. Final-grade classes have no default: you must choose Confirmed as graduating or Retained for every student. Change it per student, or use the buttons above a class to change everyone at once. New decisions only take effect after saving.
promotion.noClasses: No classes in the source year
promotion.noClassesBody: The source year has no classes with enrolled students, so there is nothing to decide yet.
promotion.classMeta: Level {level}, moves up to level {next} · {count} students
promotion.classEmpty: No active students in this class.
promotion.applyTitle: Apply to the target school year
promotion.applyHelp: Students who are promoted or retained are enrolled in a class in {target}, and students confirmed as graduating change their status to graduated. Final-grade students without a decision stay active. Enrolments in {source} are not deleted. The active school year does not change.
promotion.applyUnsaved: There are still {count} unsaved decisions. Go back to the Student decisions step and save first, because applying only uses saved decisions.
promotion.applyNoStudents: There are no students to apply yet. Check the Student decisions step.
promotion.applyConfirmBody: Students will be enrolled in a class in {target}, and students confirmed as graduating change status. Decisions that were already applied cannot be changed. If you run it again, students who were already processed are skipped.
promotion.resAlreadyHint: Skipped, already have a class in the target year
promotion.resNoDecisionHint: They stay active: not promoted and not graduated automatically. This applies to final-grade students without a decision.
promotion.unplacedHint: Fix the cause, for example create the classes in the target year, then apply again. Other students are not affected.
promotion.alreadyTitle: {count} students are already enrolled in the target year
promotion.alreadyHint: They are skipped and their decision keeps waiting. Move their class from the Students menu if needed.
promotion.copyCurriculumHint: Lesson periods per subject and the curriculum version of each level. Anything already in the target year is not overwritten.
promotion.copyTeachingPlansHint: Published ATP are copied to the target year as version 1 drafts, with their items and order; the semester is left empty. CP and TP stay the same. Anything already in the target year is not overwritten.
promotion.flowsCreatedHint: Review and publish them in My teaching materials
promotion.resNoDecisionNote: Final-grade students without a decision keep their active status. Decide them in the Student decisions step, then apply again.
promotion.statUndecidedHint: Final grade: a choice is required
promotion.classFinalNote: Final grade: choose Confirmed graduating or Retained for every student. There is no default.
promotion.graduationWarnTitle: Graduation is decided by the school
promotion.graduationWarnBody: The school decides graduation after the school examination and the teachers' council meeting; it does not follow automatically from grades. Choose Confirmed graduating only for students the school has confirmed as graduating. Final-grade students without a decision stay active.
promotion.blockedMissingFinal: {count} final-grade students still have no decision. Choose Confirmed graduating or Retained for each of them first.
promotion.blockedInvalidDetails: {count} students have invalid notes (invalid date or text too long). Fix them first.
promotion.detailReasonHint: Optional, for example why a student is retained or promoted with a note. Up to 1,000 characters.
promotion.detailFollowUpHint: Optional, for example planned coaching or remedial support. Up to 1,000 characters.
promotion.classMeetingDate: Meeting date for the whole class

help.s1Body: Under School units, click Open school to enter the school dashboard.

help.f1Q: When do extra modules become active?
help.f1A: Added modules and a higher student tier take effect as soon as payment is confirmed. The cost is prorated for the rest of the period.
help.f2Q: When does removing a module take effect?
help.f2A: A removed module stays active until the end of the current period, then disappears next period and is no longer billed.
help.f3Q: What happens if an invoice is late?
help.f3A: There is a grace period after the due date. After it, the unit is suspended temporarily and reopened automatically once the invoice is paid.
help.f4Q: How do I add another school?
help.f4A: Open School units, click Add school unit, enter the name and address, pick modules, and pay. The unit is created automatically and you become its first admin.
help.f5A: Only institution managers. Teachers and school staff sign in at their own school address.

weighted_average.title: Weighted average
weighted_average.desc: Each component score is multiplied by its weight, then divided by the total weight of the components that have a score. Components not yet graded do not pull the final grade down. This is the default.

simple_average.title: Simple average
simple_average.desc: The average of the component scores that exist, without weights. Every component counts equally.
